about: Survivor lists for cut rounds (/correct 2026-11-26, Class 2). A cut record names each surviving behaviour, its observing check and the case text it carries; a no-cut record states why the round cut nothing.

rounds.reason: Machinery and docs only: no parts/ surface changes. Adds the survivor-list gate and its push/CI wiring, extends TESTING.md rule 6, and renames drive125's colliding buildings case S7b to S7a (the crossfade keeps S7b).

rounds.surface: the sheet lifecycle: every open, close and full-raise of the Streets sheet and the Pace sheet, including the note editor's reset on close
rounds.cut: closeSheetEl, the old closeSheets body and settleClose (app2) and the hand-rolled open/close code in openPace, closePace and openClean (app3) were deleted; sheet lifecycle now runs through the SHEETS owner in app2.js

rows.behaviour: A button close freezes the current sheet height for the slide instead of snapping shut instantly
rows.case: A5 closing freezes the current height for the slide (no instant snap)
rows.observes: the sheet's inline height right after the X is clicked

rows.behaviour: The frozen height from a button close clears once the close motion has ended (480 ms), so the next open is not stuck at the old height
rows.case: A5 the frozen height clears once the close motion has ended
rows.observes: the sheet's inline height after the close transition window

rows.behaviour: Tapping away closes EVERY sheet, enumerated by class - the owner's closeAll is the single funnel behind closeSheets()
rows.case: N17 tap-away closes EVERY sheet (enumerated by class, present and future)
rows.observes: every .sheet element's open class after a tap-away

rows.behaviour: The Streets sheet opens at the HALF stop through the owner
rows.case: N24 the Streets sheet opens at HALF height
rows.observes: the Streets sheet height after opening

rows.behaviour: Dragging down from the half stop closes the sheet (the owner's gesture close)
rows.case: N29 drag down from half CLOSES the sheet
rows.observes: the sheet's open class after a downward drag from half

rows.behaviour: A flick-down close springs at the finger's own release velocity, never restarting from rest
rows.case: N30 a flick-down close keeps the finger speed (no restart from rest)
rows.observes: the close spring's start velocity against the release velocity

rows.behaviour: The flick close lands clean: no pop back up, transitions stay off through the landing
rows.case: N34 the flick close lands clean - no pop back up, transitions stay off through the landing
rows.observes: the sheet transform and transition state across the landing

rows.behaviour: A Pace sheet release settles back at the HALF stop through the owner
rows.case: N32 a Pace release settles back at the HALF stop
rows.observes: the Pace sheet height after a partial drag release

rows.behaviour: Both sheets walk the detents half -> full -> half -> closed by drag, day and night, at three phone sizes
rows.case: : open half (${h0}) -> full (${hFull}) -> half (${hHalf}) -> closed
rows.observes: the measured sheet height at each drag settle

rows.behaviour: Opening the Streets note editor raises the sheet to the full stop (through the owner's setFull)
rows.case: KB1 opening the note editor raises the Streets sheet to the full stop
rows.observes: the sheet's full class and height with the editor open

rows.behaviour: Closing the note editor returns the sheet to the half stop
rows.case: KB3 closing the editor returns the sheet to the half stop
rows.observes: the sheet's full class and height after the editor closes

rows.behaviour: Closing the Streets sheet on its X resets the note editor - the reset rides the owner's button-close funnel, editor state armed before the click
rows.case: KB4 closing the sheet on its X resets the note editor (no editor survives to the next open)
rows.observes: NOTEEDIT.openFor and the .noteEd element after the X close

rows.behaviour: A drag close resets the note editor too - the reset rides the owner's gesture-close funnel, editor state armed before the drag
rows.case: KB5 a drag close resets the note editor too (the reset rides both close funnels)
rows.observes: NOTEEDIT.openFor and the .noteEd element after the drag close

rows.behaviour: Tapping a saved clean opens its detail inside the Pace sheet, which stays open (the owner opens it keeping its height)
rows.case: P7 tapping a saved clean opens its detail INSIDE the Pace sheet (sheet stays open, pace content yields)
rows.observes: the Pace sheet's open class and content after the tap

rows.behaviour: Both settle paths start the close spring at the release velocity (the owner's gesture close kept the finger-speed start)
rows.case: 3c: both settle paths start the spring at the release velocity
rows.observes: the spring start velocity argument in the owner's close source

rows.behaviour: A close cancels a running spring first (the owner's close cancels before it decides)
rows.case: 3d: a close cancels a running spring first
rows.observes: the order of the spring cancel inside the owner's close source

rows.behaviour: The full-height cap computes from the live title rect (the sheetFullH helper moved into the owner unchanged)
rows.case: 4b: sheetFullH computes the cap from the live title rect
rows.observes: the sheetFullH( call count and fallback shape in the parts
